title: Relaxing stay
text: We stayed at Almanity for 3 nights in the heat of June. The pool was magical and provided relief from the heat and made our stay wonderful and relaxing. There were plenty of sunlounges and shade. The pool cafe was a highlight, serving delicious drinks and food. I recommend the club sandwich. MOC Garden restaurant also served delicious meals. It is a bit of a walk to get to the ancient town - but once the sun goes down the walk is ok. The breakfast provided lots of options and is a real highlight.
author: Ulrike

title: An amazingly nice hotel…
positives: The pool is absolutely amazing….rooms are well appointed, clean and comfortable beds….easy walk into the old town……
author: Kevin

title: Peaceful Stay
text: It’s very good hotel with great people. Stay, food and ambiance was so delighted.
author: Akarshan

title: Very nice
positives: Clean, cool room, quiet AC, lots of space. Lovely pool and breakfast buffet.
author: RICHARD

title: Lots of shade
text: I really enjoyed the Pool area as it was in the shade for most of the day. It was only a 5 to 10 minute walk into the main part of Hoi An, which was great as grabs (and traffic) are hard to get during peak hours. In saying that there are plenty of great restaurants nearby. After staying there a couple of days, I really started appreciating the location.

title: Great stay

title: Excellent

negatives: In the lift rooms, the wooden stairs are slippery. Also the lights for the vanity are connected to the lights in the main room which isn't ideal.

title: Es recomendado. El valor es mas alto que el promedio , pero es seguro.
text: Es un buen lugar para hospdarse , tiene restaurantes y cafes cerca , la habitación estaba limpia con pocos detalles, las toallas y sabanas muy limpias. El staff es amable, solo me preocupo el staff de la piscina , que un dia lo note tomando videos de nosotros y no tuve oportunidad de preguntar. Nos ofrecio rociar con agua fria , y luego lo descubri tomando videos. Extraño.
author: Jimmy

title: Amazing hotel experience in Hoi An
positives:
We stayed 2 nights there and everything was fantastic to us: the staff, breakfast, pool, our room and location. It was my birthday week and there was tillite birthday cake waiting in our room. We stayed in loft room which was amazing, Hotel provides bikes for free which we used them on both days. Very big and delicious breakfast. Hotel also provides cooking class and small group daily trips. 
I would definitely recommend this hotel to everyone where you relax and get the best hospitality from hotel's staff. 
Thank you all Almanity resort!
author: Sebastian

title: Wow!!
text: Great resort and spa. One of the best places we stayed in during our visit to VN. Great facilities, super helpful staff, and amazing breakfast. I highly recommend!!
author: Tomas

title: Love it
positives: Very nice . Great room. Excellent location . Very kind staff. Want to help all the time .
author: Simcha

title: Hotel right in front of Mike Beach
text: The accommodation is right in front of Mike Beach. The hotel was clean and it was nice to have afternoon tea. The rooftop pool offered a great view of Mike Beach, and having a drink at the beach beer shop after dinner brought a sense of romance... Especially for those flying during the day, the airport pickup was really convenient. I will definitely use it again next time.

title: What could be the reason for removing the star rating?
text: I understand that it is difficult to maintain the quality that was previously provided, especially during tough economic times. However, everything here, from the employees' attitudes to cleanliness, was satisfactory. I felt there was no reason it shouldn't be rated a 5. During my month-long stay in Da Nang, I stayed at six different hotels, and this place had the cleanest shower filter. Additionally, there were always lifeguards present at the pool, ensuring safety and maintaining the water quality, which allowed me to enjoy swimming comfortably. From the moment I took the taxi and greeted the staff to the cleaning personnel and restaurant employees, everyone was friendly and proactive, making my stay very comfortable. The breakfast might not be extremely diverse, but there was still a decent variety of enjoyable dishes, and fresh vegetables were provided daily, which was a plus!

author: Simon

title: Lovely holiday
text: The facility is clean and the staff's response is wonderful. The breakfast has an incredible variety, is delicious, and I am very satisfied. It is about a 10-minute walk to the old town of Hoi An, and the price is reasonable. The shuttle service includes cold water and a wet napkin service, and although the prices are reasonable, the service is comparable to that of a luxury hotel! They frequently contacted me before my departure, and when I requested a restaurant reservation, they kindly accommodated me. I will definitely visit again!
